original.statement: Traefik Pilot static configuration (e.g. pilot.token) is no longer supported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting; it must be removed from the static configuration.

decision.reason: [ev-9f3bf592e4e8] shows Pilot configured as the top-level static configuration key `pilot` (e.g. pilot.token) and says that in v3 it is "now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start", with remediation to remove all Pilot configuration from the static configuration. The whole `pilot` key no longer exists, so config-key path=pilot with change type removed is what the evidence supports.
